_comment: The ingredient names a rule, not a template: any two salvaged parts of grade 2 or better, which is what the salvage bench on the deck actually yields. A lattice shard substitutes for either, at a grade penalty -- it is the best part aboard and the worst thing to cut up for a patch kit. See docs/design/cross_theme_engine_contracts.md.

fabricate_patch_kit.description: Pack sealant, gauze and a stimulant ampoule into something you can carry.
